en:
It's a shame I couldn't find the door for the
motive <CLT=cltSTRONG>card key<CLT=cltNORMAL>... I searched real hard, too...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kokichi for a while?

No, it's too soon to give up! I'll rely on your
detective's intuition to help me instead!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi dragged me around the complex,
trying to find places to use the card key.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and I grew a little closer today,
despite my misgivings...
